data.title: Coinbase Global (COIN) Wins SEC Backing For Binaries And Flags Bitcoin Quantum Risk
data.description: Coinbase Global (NasdaqGS:COIN) is working with Evernorth as it shifts to active management of a sizeable XRP treasury in 2026. The SEC has cleared binary options that reference Coinbase operating metrics rather than spot crypto prices, creating a new regulated trading instrument. Coinbase has issued a public warning that future advances in quantum computing could threaten Bitcoin security and is urging sector wide preparation.
